versions.localizedDescription:
- Multi-live now mixes lives and VODs (up to 4 videos): add a VOD from the player's ⋯ menu, by long-pressing a VOD card or My VODs, or by pasting its link or ID in the mosaic
- VOD tiles resume where you left off, with play/pause, ±10 s, a seek bar and “Watch again”; their progress is saved and synced
- The multi-live side chat replays the chat of the VOD you hear
- The multi-live “+” accepts a channel link or @name
- Chat: the Hype Train now shows up as soon as it is incoming, with its checkmarks, how many more supports it needs and a countdown, like on Twitch
- Chat: see the Hype Train leave the station, the time left on each level, and a short message when a level or the whole train completes
- Chat: the Hype Train banner no longer freezes when the Twitch web session has expired
- Chat: the folded event icons show the time left on the Hype Train
- Chat: if Twitch bans your account from a channel's chat, the chat now keeps going in read-only mode (without your account) with a clear banner and a "Retry with my account" button, instead of going silent with the message box still active.
- Chat: when you're timed out in a chat, a line now says for how long.
- Chat: the app's own lines in the chat are now labelled "System" in your language.
- Subscribed to a channel (or Turbo)? With the web session connected, its lives now play through your Twitch account, without ad breaks (Settings → Player → Watch ad-free with my sub).
- During a channel's ad break, the player now explains the purple “Commercial break in progress” screen, shows when the stream comes back and mutes the sound meanwhile.
- Live source descriptions no longer claim the proxies are ad-free: they still get the channel's ad breaks.
- The chat no longer stays stuck on “Connecting…” when an emote service is slow or blocked, and says so after three failed attempts.
- Reopening a VOD in the same session no longer shows its restored muted parts in orange on the progress bar.
- Muted parts of recent VODs in the MP4 format keep their sound again when Twitch still serves it, instead of being swapped for the silent version.
- Emote cards also open from a message thread, with sharp FrankerFaceZ emotes and badges.
- Emote cards now show the scope and author of BetterTTV, FFZ and 7TV emotes, the 7TV original name, zero-width and modifier emotes, and a link to the emote's page.
- Twitch emote cards show the emote type (global, sub tier, channel points), the channel it belongs to (live or not, with See channel) and its other sub emotes of the same tier.
- Improvements and fixes
- Signalements : plus de relecture d'un retour terminé
- Signalements : réponses relues toutes les minutes app ouverte

- A reply to your report, a drop ready or claimed, a finished download: with the app open, a banner inside the app tells you, even if notifications aren't allowed; one that arrives while the app is in the background without permission shows up when you come back.

- In landscape, Hide under the chat banners (pinned message, drops, polls, predictions, raid) folds them into one line of icons with the poll or prediction countdown; tap it to bring them back. The choice is remembered (Settings → Customize).
- When the developer replies to one of your reports (or changes its status), you get a notification, even with the app in the background; tap it to open My reports.

- In landscape, the chat now shows the pinned message, polls, predictions and raids, plus a card when the channel has drops (reward, watch time, end date, details) that you can dismiss (Settings → Customize → Channel drops).
- Tap an emote or a badge in the chat to see its exact name and where it comes from (Twitch, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ, 7TV), then copy it or add it to your message.
- BetterTTV: personal emotes of BTTV Pro users show up once BTTV announces them, and emotes added to the channel during the stream appear right away.
- Pin your favourite streamers: long-press a followed channel (live or offline) and pick "Pin to the top of Following". Pinned channels show first, with a small pin next to their name.

- Lives never get closer than 4 seconds to the edge anymore (closer, playback could stall), including when skipping ahead or tapping Live. In landscape, the purple line between the video and the chat is gone; a small handle still lets you resize the chat.

- Live notifications through ntfy: fixed on the server side (ntfy.sh was turning the server away), and the Test button now tells you when ntfy.sh is refusing messages for now instead of saying the server can't be reached.

- Pick an app icon in Settings → General → Appearance: Classic, Purple, Night, Light, Contrast or Neon; “Contrast” stays the sharpest with iOS 26's clear and tinted icons. An app signed with a certificate's generic identifier can't change its icon: the setting says so.

- Chat: the room's modes (followers only and for how long, subscribers only, slow mode…) show above the message box, the channel's chat rules are shown to accept before your first message, and a message Twitch refuses is removed with the reason.
- Expert settings (Settings → Other): if the official Workers go down, give the address of your own Worker; it's checked, then tried first for lives, VODs and playlists, or used for everything.
- Améliorations et corrections
- Icônes : « Merge Entitlements » n'existe pas encore dans Feather publié

- Lives: double-tap no longer skips ahead; in landscape it shows or hides the chat, and a red Live button with the delay brings you back to the edge after a pause.
- Categories: filter the lives by language (all, or a single one).

- Pick the order of the live sources in Settings → Player: if one doesn't answer, the next one takes over; picking a source from the player menu moves it to the top.
- My reports: a new “Seen” status once your message has been read.
- Fixed a black screen in “Source” on Luminous Europe for channels that stream with multiple encodes (each quality now keeps its own name).
- Téléchargements : l'app sait qu'elle est à l'écran dès son lancement
- Downloads run faster while the app is open, and iOS takes over when you leave it; a stopped download now says why (connection lost, storage full, segments refused by Twitch).
- ntfy : le réglage reste activé quand le serveur n'est pas prêt
- Icônes au choix en fichiers séparés, comme Feather
- Icône de l'app : un refus d'iOS se voit, nouvel essai
- Pick an app icon in Settings → General → Appearance: Classic, Purple, Night, Light, Contrast or Neon, each with dark and tinted versions — “Contrast” stays sharp with iOS 26's clear icons.
- Instant live notifications, even with the app closed, through the free ntfy app (Settings → Features in testing): add the topic shown there in ntfy, and tapping a notification opens the stream.
- Multi-live on iPad: the chat of the stream you hear shows next to the mosaic (button in the mosaic, or Settings → Player).

- Downloads keep going in the background, even with the app closed; the chat can be kept and replayed offline (emotes included); a finished download can be exported as a single file (Files, AirDrop, VLC).
- Fixed a black screen on some recent VODs with muted parts (Twitch's new MP4 format); their original sound is restored too while Twitch still has it.
- Multi-live: watch up to four streams side by side. Long-press a live card (or use the player's ⋯ menu) to add it, then tap Watch in the bar at the bottom; tap a stream to hear it.

- Download a whole VOD or just a part of it (from one time to another) to watch offline, from the player's ⋯ menu. Parts muted for copyrighted music keep their original sound while Twitch still has it. Your downloads are in the My VODs tab.
